decision: Record the combined leading-icon text approved by the owner so the Button-only start/end placement, the Toggle-only icon-only branch and the IconButton-only required icon coexist; no other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission.

limits: Scope convention:leading-icon only. Button alone may place its decorative icon at start or end through iconPosition, end by default. Toggle alone may render a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label. IconButton alone requires one decorative ReactElement icon, named separately by its required label.
No other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission. Interactive icons and icons as the sole carrier of meaning remain excluded.

This record supersedes as current text, but does not erase, the combined Button and Toggle approval (docs/components/toggle/v0.1/prop-naming-approval-leading-icon-combined.json, contentHash sha256:60969be2cb3bfeda5375f19bb3d66bd265ae2b61de0331e169828ae5eaceb19a) and the IconButton approval (docs/components/icon-button/v0.1/prop-naming-approval.json, contentHash sha256:29561623f1153d6b3eeaf4b5ca560059d3ee442d6ef3e23088d2978effe9367a). Both files stay byte-identical and are pinned below.
The IconButton approval is a parallel branch from an older base; it is pinned as a historical record, not spliced into the linear receipt chain. Historical receipt bytes and hashes remain immutable.

before.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Button alone may place this icon before or after its label, after it by default. Toggle alone also accepts a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label.
before.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Button alone also permits its iconPosition start/end slot, default end. Toggle alone permits its icon-only branch when icon and accessible label are both required.
before.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. Two scoped exceptions apply: Button with iconPosition may place the icon after its label, and Toggle with a required icon and accessible label may render icon-only. No other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission, and interactive icons remain excluded.
